title.narrative: Percentage change in average index of household asset among SCTP beneficiary households (HH asset index)

description.narrative: The mean asset index is a proxy for household wealth and measures the number and weighted value of animal and other productive and household assets. Values of assets in Malawi Kwacha are estimated by the households themselves based on the prevailing local market prices and levels of depreciation. This will be assess if a household has a cushion to adjust in case of shocks since a household with higher asset value is less vulnerable to disasters and food shocks than a household with lower values.
